text:
noah: quick idea 1: can we add a tiny "econ pulse" on the model card that shows 30m history + 12m simple forecast (token cost stacked with cache savings)? minimal footprint in the row.
tess: yes but we need to agree sampling semantics. full scan for every model card will kill the aggregator.
omar: reuse sampled traces (0.2%) + carry sample_weight forward. aggregator can do weighted per-minute sums and a linear extrap for the 12m forecast.
jin: UX: if estimated, show a small badge 'est' + a tooltip with sample_rate and sample_n. also show a faint dashed line for forecast.
noah: API sketch: GET /api/console/v1/models/{model}/econ_pulse?history=30m&forecast=12m
resp fields: timestamps[], token_cost[], cache_savings[], is_estimated, sample_rate, sample_n, forecast_points[]
tess: please also include anomaly_score[] so the UI can flag sudden spikes client-side without a separate alert pipeline.
omar: impl note: store per-minute sample_n in the timeseries so tiny buckets can be suppressed. For CIs we can compute approximate var using weighted sums (24X cheap2).
jin: rollout: behind feature-flag + opt-in alpha tenants. default off. console setting "show econ pulses".
noah: cache tag consistency is a blocker: router tags prefetch as "prefetch_v1", sidecar uses "sidecar_kv". we'll need a normalization map.
ops-bot: Job scheduled: telemetry/ingest-add-sample-n-and-cache-tag-normalize @ 2024-10-02T06:00Z
tess: backfill: rather than re-ingesting full data, we can extrapolate past sparkline points from sampled series to reconstruct 7d history for UX. cheaper. note in ticket.
omar: for chains: attribute generated tokens to the model that produced them; attribute input-token reads to the consuming route. prevents double-counting. document on the cost attribution page.
jin: small accessibility ask: ensure the tiny sparkline has alt text and a bigger modal view on click with full legend.
noah: i'll open a tracker with mock CSV and a compact Figma wire. tagging @tess @omar @jin.
tess: i'll own the backend endpoint + flag. will PR the shape and tests.
omar: i'll handle ingest changes and normalization PR.
jin: UX will build placeholder components with toggles for sample_rate and show_estimates.
noah: thanks all. will post ticket link and mock data later. :sparkles:
